claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Halcinonide is a potent glucocorticoid receptor agonist; at 2.5 uM it is expected to kill mainly glucocorticoid-sensitive hematologic and lymphoid cancer cells via glucocorticoid receptor-mediated apoptosis, while most non-hematologic lines remain resistant.
